customMethods.name: saveAssetType
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("saveAssetType() called")
	assetTypeInfo = dict(self.view.custom.values)
	assetTypeId = assetTypeInfo['assetTypeId']
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
		
	if assetTypeId is None:
		system.perspective.print("checking name...")
		if system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTypes({'assetTypeName':assetTypeInfo['assetTypeName'], 'parentTypeId':assetTypeInfo['parentId']}).rowCount > 0:
			system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'This asset type already exists'})
			return
	
		assetTypeId, msg = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetType(assetTypeInfo, userId)
		self.view.custom.values.assetTypeId = assetTypeId
	else:
		system.perspective.print("Caling updateAssetType() ...")
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.updateAssetType(assetTypeInfo, userId)

	# Tooling type and its new-tool defaults: saved for a tooling type, and when a type stops being one
	if not msg and assetTypeId:
		isTooling = bool(assetTypeInfo.get('isTooling'))
		known = system.kanoa.tooling.getToolTypes({'assetTypeId': assetTypeId})
		if isTooling or (hasattr(known, 'getRowCount') and known.getRowCount() > 0):
			typeInfo = dict(self.view.custom.tooling)
			typeInfo.update({'assetTypeId': assetTypeId, 'isTooling': isTooling})
			ok, msg = system.kanoa.tooling.saveToolType(typeInfo, userId)
			if msg: self.view.refreshBinding("custom.values")

	if msg: system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': "Couldn't save Asset Type. %s"%msg})
	else: system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Asset Type saved'})
		
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.data") #Update the Tree Selector
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshAssetTypes", {})
	return

customMethods.name: deleteAssetType
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("deleteAssetType() called")
	assetTypeId = self.view.params.value.assetTypeId
	if assetTypeId is None: return
	userId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId(self.session.props.auth.user)
		
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.deleteAssetType(assetTypeId, userId)
	if not retVal:
		if 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg) or 'The DELETE statement conflicted with the SAME TABLE REFERENCE constraint' in str(msg):
			msg = 'This asset type is being used. Please remove any assets within this asset type before deleting'
#			system.perspective.openPopup('userDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteAssetHistory'}, title='Delete Asset and Historical data', modal=True, overlayDismiss=True)	
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': msg})
	else:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': msg})		

	self.view.params.value.assetTypeId = None
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.data") #Update the Tree Selector
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshAssetTypes", {})

	return

customMethods.name: toolingParentId
customMethods.script:
# Where a new tooling type goes: beside the selected tooling type, else under Tooling, else beside any tooling type
	if assetTypeId is not None:
		sel = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTypes({'assetTypeId': assetTypeId}), 0)
		if sel['assetTypeId'] is not None and sel['isTooling']: return sel['parentId']
	store = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTypes({'assetTypeName': 'Tooling', 'isTooling': False})
	if store.getRowCount(): return store.getValueAt(0, 'assetTypeId')
	tools = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetTypes({'isTooling': True})
	return tools.getValueAt(0, 'parentId') if tools.getRowCount() else None
